summary.zh: 開放題、報名、前後測；先決定要收什麼與保留多久。
summary.en: Open questions, registration and surveys. Decide what to collect and how long to keep it.

handoff.zh: 匯出 responses.csv 或 tttc.csv，帶到 TTTC；審閱 seeds.json 後帶到 Polis。
handoff.en: Export responses.csv or tttc.csv to TTTC. Review seeds.json before starting Polis.

summary.zh: 以一組問題逐一引導參與者說明經驗與理由，整理個別訪談後再比較觀點。
summary.en: Guide each participant through questions about experiences and reasons, then compare perspectives across individual interviews.

handoff.zh: 審閱逐字內容與摘要，匯出 tttc.csv 整理議題，再挑選可討論的陳述。
handoff.en: Review transcripts and summaries. Export tttc.csv for synthesis, then select statements for deliberation.

summary.zh: 投下同意、不同意或略過；觀察群體之間可以一起前進的陳述。
summary.en: Agree, disagree or pass. Explore statements that can connect different opinion groups.

handoff.zh: 下載原始 CSV 後在資料工作台驗證、轉檔；保留歧見，再把方案送去排序。
handoff.en: Validate and convert exported CSV in the data workbench. Preserve disagreement before ranking proposals.

title.zh: 讓現場與線上一起發言

summary.zh: 以簡報同步收件、主持問答與現場討論。
summary.en: Collect contributions alongside a presentation and facilitate questions and discussion.

handoff.zh: 匯出文字與逐字稿後審閱，整理成 tttc.csv，讓現場意見進入下一輪。
handoff.en: Review exported text and transcripts, then prepare tttc.csv so in-person contributions enter the next round.

title.en: Respond and start the next round

summary.zh: 留下主辦者回應、責任人、時間與可追蹤的下一步。
summary.en: Record the organizer response, responsible person, deadline and next action.

handoff.zh: 把回覆與未解問題納入下一輪前測；再邀請原參與者與缺席的聲音。
handoff.en: Carry responses and unresolved questions into the next survey. Invite returning participants and missing voices.

title.en: Turn contributions into a topic map

summary.zh: 將文字整理成主題、主張與可回查的引述；由人確認解讀。
summary.en: Organize text into topics, claims and traceable quotes. People review the interpretation.

handoff.zh: 讀回原始引述，保留不同觀點；審閱後把短陳述帶到 Polis。
handoff.en: Check source quotes and preserve contrasting views. Take reviewed short statements into Polis.

summary.zh: 以引導對話整理本人確認的價值卡，再成對比較哪些價值值得注意；保留個人故事的脈絡。
summary.en: Turn guided conversations into participant-reviewed value cards, then compare what deserves attention while preserving the context of each story.

handoff.zh: 把價值與尚未解決的張力寫回議題說明，帶入小組對話。
handoff.en: Carry values and unresolved tensions into the issue brief and small-group dialogue.

summary.zh: 在有限預算下比較方案，公開限制、成本與選擇理由。
summary.en: Compare proposals under a budget, showing constraints, costs and reasons.

handoff.zh: 把配置结果、限制與歧見交給主辦者回應；不直接當成正式預算承諾。
handoff.en: Send allocations, constraints and disagreement for an organizer response; they are not a formal budget commitment.

summary.zh: 用附出處的單選題檢查理解，指出需補充說明的地方。
summary.en: Use sourced multiple-choice questions to check understanding and identify material that needs clarification.

handoff.zh: 依答對率與常見錯誤補充材料，再開啟討論；協助需要更多說明的參與者。
handoff.en: Use answer patterns to improve learning materials, then begin discussion with support for people who need clarification.

summary.zh: 一起補足方案的目的、做法、資源需求與評估方式。
summary.en: Develop a proposal’s purpose, actions, resource needs and evaluation.

handoff.zh: 將候選方案與評估標準帶入排序或預算配置；保留修訂脈絡。
handoff.en: Take proposals and criteria into ranking or budgeting and retain revision history.

summary.zh: 看清主張、支持理由、質疑與證據之間的關係。
summary.en: Explore how claims, supporting reasons, objections and evidence relate.

handoff.zh: 把仍缺證據的問題帶回共同學習，把可調整的設計帶往方案討論。
handoff.en: Return gaps in evidence to shared learning and possible design changes to proposal development.

summary.zh: 圍繞法案或議程收集支持、反對、修正理由與書面意見；送出前確認公開範圍。
summary.en: Collect positions, reasons for amendments and written testimony about a bill or agenda item. Review what will be public before submitting.

handoff.zh: 匯出 tttc.csv，整理書面意見與原文引述，再請有權回應者逐項說明。
handoff.en: Export tttc.csv, synthesize testimony with source quotations, then request a response from the responsible authority.

summary.zh: 每次比較兩個方案，累積相對優先序；可本機操作或建立短期多人收件室。
summary.en: Compare two proposals at a time to build relative priorities, locally or in a temporary shared room.

handoff.zh: 匯出通用 JSON 或群體成果，附上涵蓋率、歧見與解讀，再交付回應。
handoff.en: Export portable JSON or aggregate results with coverage, disagreement and interpretation, then request a response.
